ex.t: 据英国财政部分析，由于制造商们努力规避糖税，饮料中的糖含量如今减少了4500万公斤。

ex.s: Despite a weight of up to 300 kilograms, they can run at a speed of around 64 kilometers per hour and are also excellent swimmers.
ex.t: 尽管体重可达 300 公斤，它们的奔跑速度仍能达到每小时约 64 公里，而且也是出色的游泳者。

ex.s: By contrast, the largest animal species so far found on our planet is the blue whale, which can grow up to almost 30 metres in length and weigh over 130,000 kilos.
ex.t: 相比之下，迄今地球上发现的最大的动物物种是蓝鲸，它体长可接近30米，体重超过13万公斤。

ex.s: Instead of saying “I want to lose three kilos”, I would say “I want to run two kilometres in eight minutes” or “I want to be able to do 30 push-ups”.
ex.t: 与其说我想减掉三公斤，我会说我想在八分钟内跑两公里或我想能做30个俯卧撑。

ex.s: Since I must carry all of my food and supplies with me, my bag weighs about 30 kilograms.
ex.t: 由于我必须携带所有的食物和物资，我的背包重约30公斤。

ex.s: Consequently, they purchased a block of white marble more than 5 metres in length and 6,000 kilograms in weight.
ex.t: 于是，他们购买了一块长逾5米、重达6000公斤的白大理石料。
